contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

: Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma, Trier mint, commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted and cuirassed bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: VRBS ROMA. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars over. In exergue: TRP. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 1.84gms, die axis: 12
